trim_hint: Play video and click marker buttons to set start and end points
trim_choose_left: Select video on the left or click "+ Add files" to load player
split_title: Split Video into Equal Segments (No Re-encoding)
audio_mode_sync_desc: Audio is sped up/slowed down proportionally to video
audio_mode_original: Keep original audio (audio NOT sped up)
audio_mode_original_desc: Audio speed stays 1.0x, video is altered separately
audio_mode_custom_desc: Independent speed multiplier for the audio track
audio_mode_mute_desc: Completely remove audio from output video
pitch_preserve_desc: Prevents chipmunk distortion during speedup (atempo filter)
merge_desc: Files will be concatenated sequentially into one video without sync issues.
msg_merge_min_files: Add at least 2 files to the queue to merge!
